snippet.title: W̶͍̥̟͕͜͝o̶̭̪̹̲͐̾o̷̪̠̟͓̓ Full Plays... Super Taxi Driver 2006 [No Commentary]
snippet.description:
Hello everyone today we are playing a game called Super Taxi Driver 2006,
                                              Hope you enjoy.
[The Developers]
Team6 Game Studios
[The Publishers]
Purple Hills
[The Release Date]
12 June 2006

▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬₪₪₪₪ஜ۩۞۩ஜ₪₪₪₪▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬
                🎮I played this game on Windows 11🎮
✖️Game works fine with no problems, Oh man this game was really difficult to complete I had to cut all the failed attempts I just left one because it was funny, This game was suggested for me by @longplayer2004, No one actually completed this game before on YouTube one person had managed to get to level 14, and yes I cheated I modified the money because every time you lose you lose the money and if you don't have any left you have to start over from beginning, I skipped level 14 because I tried so hard to complete but I couldn't as you can see through bad days how many trieds I did and on the desktop clock, Well anyway I am the first ever to complete this game on YouTube✖️
▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬₪₪₪₪ஜ۩۞۩ஜ₪₪₪₪▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬
